summary: Slow colour-negative and print model with fine grain, mild halation and a near-neutral print balance. The 100 in the name is a speed-class label, not a measured ISO speed.
constants_origin: Camera characteristic-curve parameters were fit to this project's digitization of the cited Kodak Alaris chart. They are not a numeric table from the manufacturer. Print balance was then solved inside this model so a flat gray stays near neutral. Not fitted to a scan and not taken from another film-simulation project.
notes: Illustrative parameters only. Physical resemblance to any real film is unverified. Camera-curve gamma, toe and layer spacing were fit to a digitization of E-4046 Status M curves. The fit is unverified against scans.
